name: Revisions Control Ultimate
author: Interactive Net Solutions

sections.description:
Revisions Control Ultimate allows users to manage WordPress post revisions and autosave settings.

With this plugin, you can:
– Limit or disable post revisions.
– Enable or disable autosave for performance optimization.
– Automatically clean up revisions.
– Fully compatible with the latest WordPress versions.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Revision Control to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I disable revisions?

Set the Number of Revisions to Keep option to 0 in Settings > Revision Control.

Can I disable autosave?

Yes, uncheck the Enable Autosave option.

How do I remove all revisions from my database?

This plugin does not delete existing revisions, but you can use a plugin like WP-Optimize to clean them up.
